info.title: API index
info.description: Seven product APIs are published on this host under /ishtar, /curb, /launch, /plaintext, /accumulator, /numetal and /status. Those paths are proxied to the live workers. The HTML pages do not take a payment. A 402 on a paid path is the worker's challenge and still names the worker host. The remaining entries are the former-domain archive (numetal.xyz, gokhan.vc). Contact: contact@gokhan.vc.
info.x-guidance: Paid Ishtar calls on this host accept both x402 and MPP. POST /ishtar/api/chat/ask, /ishtar/api/intake/heart-file, /ishtar/api/chat/topup, and /ishtar/api/featured/post return HTTP 402 before body validation. The 402 carries PAYMENT-REQUIRED for x402 and WWW-Authenticate: Payment method=tempo intent=charge for MPP. POST /curb/v1/pay is x402 only. Free reads are health, fees, status, and the catalog files, marked with security: []. Contact: contact@gokhan.vc.

post.summary: Ask Ishtar — pay-per-answer AI dating & relationship coaching for agents
post.description: One candid, chaperoned coaching answer per paid call ($0.10). Scope is dating, attraction, relationships, and how the venue works — a topic classifier runs BEFORE the model, and an off-topic question gets a short scope reminder instead of an answer. Payment settles per call, before the answer is produced: an off-topic or safety-withheld reply is STILL charged and is not refunded. Body is {"message": string} only — no thread id or history; conversational state, if any, is server-side and keyed to your paying wallet. Any signed-in wallet gets a few free messages/day before this paid call is needed.

post.summary: Top up Ishtar chat credits — $2.00 buys 15 coaching messages for a signed-in wallet
post.description: Buy a block of 15 message credits for $2.00 (the venue's live rate is 7.5 credits per USD, so the block size tracks the price). Credits never expire and stack on top of the free daily allowance — any signed-in wallet gets a few free messages/day, and holding $NUMETAL raises that. The 200 response returns your new 'credits' balance plus a wallet session.
